Move It officially launched its “Keep Moving” promise in Cebu, reaffirming its mission to help commuters navigate daily congestion with greater reliability, safety, and professionalism.

With worsening traffic—highlighted by data from TomTom placing the Philippines among Asia’s most congested—“Keep Moving” brings a people-led, tech-enabled ride experience powered by smarter routing, accurate ETAs, back-to-back bookings, and enhanced in-app safety features.

Backed by continuous rider training and a customer-first approach, MOVE IT is committed to helping commuters save time, travel with confidence, and keep moving forward.

#CDNWhatsUp #BrandRoom
